explanation: The component fires only at D2 of a trial where the agent chose a2 but landed in S1 (a rare transition), and it is 0 at every D1 and GO step and on every other kind of trial. It reaches about 9-10 in the first third of the episode (trials 10-30), about 7-9 around trials 55-85, and about 2-5 after trial 85 or when such trials come back to back, falling to 0 by trials 95-99.
